evidence_basis: Pinned repository manifest and receipt journal, internally cross-checked; not a fresh RPC verification.
token_id_mapping: NFT token IDs 1 through 495 correspond to weight shard indices 0 through 494 in export order.
shard_runtime_layout: One STOP byte (0x00), followed by the payload. Runtime Keccak-256 hashes cover the STOP byte plus payload. Logical export offsets exclude the STOP byte.
missing_fields: Per-shard payload-only cryptographic hash is not separately supplied; runtime code hash is available for every shard.
